newsitem.title: USA: PartnerRe Ltd files to offer preferred.
newsitem.headline: PartnerRe Ltd files to offer preferred.

text.p: PartnerRe Ltd filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to 10 million shares of Series A cumulative preferred stock with a $25 liquidation value.

Joint lead managers for the offering are Morgan Stanley Dean Witter and Smith Barney Inc, with Credit Suisse First Boston, Oppenheimer & Co Inc, Prudential Securities Inc, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette, PaineWebber Inc and UBS Securities as underwriters.
The Bermuda-based company said proceeds from the sale will be used to finance a portion of its acquisition of a unit of Swiss Re.
Through its wholly owned subsidiary, Partner Reinsurance Co Ltd., PartnerRe provides catastrophe reinsurance to insurance companies worldwide.
